exceptions.title: prefers a render element's `aria-label` over an associated label
exceptions.reason: The case gives the `aria-label` as a prop of a React element in `render`. Base UI reads that prop with `React.isValidElement`. In Vue, an element with props of its own is the `#render` slot, and a part does not see an attribute that the slot adds. Base UI also does not see an attribute that a render function adds.
The prop makes the parent checkbox of a `CheckboxGroup`, which Vase UI does not have.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `aria-label` to find out if a label names the checkbox, and `$attrs` is not reactive, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the element, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

The part reads `aria-labelledby` to find out if a label names the checkbox, and `$attrs` is not reactive, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the element, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
